encodes: The chain-reading half of the walk, marked as such.
provenance: x402 offer-receipt extension section 5.6.4, as proposed in pull request 3827 at commit 0e492d6 and not on main
description: The full section 5.6.4 walk, starting from only the receipt, the salt and the asset: find the nonces this payer consumed in a window, then open the commitment on exactly one. Requires an archive-capable RPC for Base Sepolia. Included so the chain-dependent half is named rather than hidden, but a runner without RPC access should skip it and report that, not fail it.

context.rpc: any Base Sepolia endpoint that serves eth_getLogs over the window around the receipt issuedAt
context.note: The candidate count is what the window actually produced on 2026-10-18 and will grow as this payer makes more payments; a runner should assert "exactly one opens", not the count.
